rationale: The breakout thesis has shown zero follow-through — maximum favorable excursion of just 0.05% in six minutes, per-minute volume collapsing from ~74k to ~3k shares, and lower closes grinding price back inside the base toward the 18.55 EMA and 18.49 invalidation on a still-weak tape. With only $222 of loss budget remaining, paying the full defined risk (~$118 more to invalidation) on a stalled momentum long is poor use of capital; I'd rather be flat and re-engage on confirmation (volume reclaim above 18.72 to re-long, or a decisive 18.49 break to short). FLIP_TO_SHORT is rejected because price still holds above session VWAP and the 9-EMA, so the short evidence is not meaningfully stronger than simply going flat.
